title: Space mein kuch nahi hai... toh rocket kis cheez ko push karta hai?
description: Season 2 Episode 17: A rocket pushes nothing — it throws its own mass backward, and momentum conservation carries it forward.
ncert_chapter: NCERT XI Ch 4 (conservation of linear momentum, rocket propulsion)
hook_text: Space khaali hai. Rocket kis cheez ko PUSH karta hai? 🚀
concept: A rocket pushes nothing — it throws its own mass backward, and momentum conservation carries it forward.
on_screen_cues: skateboard + bag thrown → "p_before = 0 = p_after" → "m_gas·v_gas (←) = m_rocket·v_rocket (→)" → "Exhaust ≈ 3 km/s" → "NCERT XI Ch 4"
pinned_comment: Agar tum space mein phase ho aur paas sirf ek wrench hai — ISS tak kaise pahunchoge? 🔧😏
suggested_titles: "Rocket space mein kis cheez ko push karta hai?" / "Conservation of momentum — universe ka sabse strict rule"
elevenlabs_script:
Gudiya: [confused] Chintu, zameen pe chalte hain toh zameen ko push karte hain. Space mein rocket kya push karta hai? Wahan toh khaali hai!
Chintu: [mischievously] Rocket kuch push nahi karta.
Gudiya: [surprised] Toh aage kaise jaata hai?!
Chintu: [excited] Woh apna hi maal peeche PHENKTA hai!
Gudiya: [confused] Matlab?
Chintu: [cheerfully] Skateboard pe khade ho. Ek bhaari bag aage phenko. Tum kahan jaoge?
Gudiya: [thoughtful] Peeche...
Chintu: [elated] Exactly! Bag aage, tum peeche. Kisi ko push nahi kiya. Bas phenka!
Gudiya: [curious] Toh rocket bhi phenk raha hai?
Chintu: [excited] Garam gas! Har second TONNES gas, 3 kilometre per second se peeche. Gas peeche, rocket aage!
Gudiya: [gasps] Bina kisi cheez ko touch kiye?!
Chintu: [dramatic tone] Haan. Yeh CONSERVATION OF MOMENTUM hai. Shuru mein total momentum zero. Gas ka peeche, rocket ka aage... ab bhi total zero!
Gudiya: [thoughtful] Matlab jitna momentum gas peeche leti hai, exactly utna rocket aage leta hai?
Chintu: [proudly] Universe ka sabse strict hisaab. Kabhi galat nahi hua.
Gudiya: [elated] Toh rocket ko hawa ki zaroorat hi nahi... isliye space mein aur bhi accha chalta hai!
Chintu: [cheerfully] Bilkul! Hawa toh rocket ko slow karti hai.
Gudiya: [curious] Chintu, darwaze ka handle kinaare pe kyun hota hai, beech mein kyun nahi?
Chintu: [mischievously] Woh next video mein!
